findings.description: D-002 delegation under-specified: runtime.js:59-61 derives CLI --help from `surface.usage || command.usage`, and read-member's reused parseSlash/formatError hard-code `/read-member` (read-member.js:29-31, :125-129). A naive surfaces re-export would make `read-member-reports --help` and errors say `read-member`.
findings.resolution: Plan now specifies a command FACTORY / shared core parameterized by command identity: share parse/filter/cursor/handler/format LOGIC, override own name/description/usage/surfaces.cli.usage + slash usage + error-prefix. AC5 + US-004 require `read-member-reports --help` to show its own identity, asserted by the dispatcher test. (Flagged by codex + copilot; Claude raised the related coverage gap.)

findings.description: Plan missed the lead briefing golden. The lead cheat-sheet renders `${usage} — ${description}` per lead-visible command (slashCommandsCheatSheet -> listCommands('lead')), and tests/briefing-render.test.js byte-compares tests/golden/briefing-lead.md. Both the read-member wording rewrite AND a new lead-visible read-member-reports change it.
findings.resolution: Verified the cheat-sheet enumeration in source. Added tests/golden/briefing-lead.md regeneration to Files-to-Modify, Technical Constraints, Risk Areas, AC6b, US-005, US-007, and the decomposition sharedFiles. briefing-member.md is unaffected (lead-only commands).

findings.description: Plan omitted plugins/crews/CHANGELOG.md from the release. Crews releases keep CHANGELOG.md + AGENTS.md in lockstep with the 6 version stamps.
findings.resolution: Added CHANGELOG.md `## 3.24.0` prepend to Files-to-Modify, Technical Constraints, AC6, and US-006. Confirmed CHANGELOG.md exists (head `## 3.23.2`).

findings.description: The 'unaffected (verified)' callout for other pinned command-list tests was unsafe; a lead-visible CLI command may break more than the two pinned arrays.
findings.resolution: Source-checked the remaining candidates: dispatcher-routes (curated subset), shim-deprecation (shim-dir derived; no shim for read-member-reports), command-compat-list-members (member rows not commands), cheatsheet (fixed local list), tool-help (legacy shims), briefing-discoverability (>=20 lower bound) are NOT auto-broken; briefing-lead.md golden IS (F-002). Softened the plan to 'run the full suite; the suite is the source of truth' with the known-breaker + not-affected list explicit (Files-to-Modify, US-007 AC).

findings.resolution: AC1 + AC4 spell out the combinations; US-007 + US-002 add explicit regression tests for combined filters, legacy/missing-kind, --all/--since/--peek interaction, empty outbox. (Claude + codex + copilot.)
